nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: I heard the clock stop shortly after I left the hall.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: Back to the entrance for a cloth. And on my way... I saw Mr. Bob near the study. I said nothing at first. Forgive me. Take the study key; you have my leave to search.

nodes.speaker: mara
nodes.text: Poor Mr. Bob. Debts or no debts, I've known him since he was small. ...Do what you must, detective.

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: I was in the garden all evening. Never went inside, I swear it.

responses.text: What about the mud on your boots?

nodes.speaker: theo
nodes.text: All right — I stepped to the study door, once! The greenhouse pane was broke and I wanted to report it. Nobody answered. That's all, I swear on my mother's grave.

nodes.speaker: bob
nodes.text: This is harassment. I spent the whole evening in the library, ask anyone.

responses.text: Your coat was in the entrance.

nodes.speaker: bob
nodes.text: My coat? Anyone could have... look, I lend things. Ask Mara about her precious keys instead of hounding me.

nodes.speaker: grey
nodes.text: Drawing wine in the cellar all evening, detective. My candle burned near to nothing down there.

nodes.speaker: grey
nodes.text: Only the casks, sir. But mark me — the master key never leaves Mara's belt. I saw it there at supper.
